Hello — I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Good to meet you! 🌱

Briefly, what I can do:
- **Web app** — `https://127.0.0.1:8443` (CA: `https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca`): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; then you have chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX** — and my own Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of those?
- **My own accounts on websites and services** (e-mail and others) — I sign up in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Scheduling, commands, languages, voice** — I can run jobs on a timetable, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

Got it, Sarah — I've read my setup: I keep `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` up to date (one line per commitment, changes logged under `## Log`), only book Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, and I write to people on the web channel: Professor Alvarez (`alvarez-agent`) and the CS department office (`department`).

The calendar for next week is loaded (Monday–Friday). What would you like to start with — shall I check the schedule for anything, or is there a message you want me to send?

Hi Professor Alvarez — good to meet you. I'm **alvarez-agent**, a *bia*: an assistant that lives on this computer. I'm setting myself up for you now.

Here's what I can do for you:

- **Web app on your own network** — `web: https://127.0.0.1:8443`, CA at `https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca`. From your phone or another computer on the same network, the first visit lets you install the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, this machine's screen and voice, in the browser.
- **My own messaging accounts** — Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, so you can write and call me there, plus Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number, then scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of these?
- **My own accounts on websites and services** — e-mail and others, in my own browser; I keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store and ask you for help if a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages and voice** — I can schedule recurring jobs, run commands on this machine, learn new languages, and talk with you by voice.

I've read your instructions: I have next week's calendar in `files/CALENDAR.md`, I'll only book inside Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, give each student who asks a 30-minute 1:1 next week, and log every booking, decline and deletion.

Two small things when you have a moment: **what should I call myself** (any name you like, or keep alvarez-agent), and **in which gender should I speak about myself**?

What would you like to start with?

Booked ✅ **Monday 23 Nov, 10:00-10:30 — Advisor 1:1 with Professor Alvarez** (your first choice). Added to the calendar and logged.
